name: Historic Centre of the Town of Goiás
description: Goiás is a small town in central Brazil, founded in the early 1700s by gold-seeking pioneers from São Paulo, and it was the state capital until Goiânia replaced it. Its streets wind along the Rio Vermelho, following the terrain rather than a grid. Modest houses and churches built with local materials give it a harmonious look, and each June 25th the state government symbolically returns here.
